title: RS7: exact global SUM rescue from the first-R pass

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and fixed secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME elementary-source RS7 program and exact configuration in proof.md and recycle-sieve.md recover the entire s with unconditional probability at least1019/1024 under independent ideal coset copies. All four resources and the zero count law hold jointly on every execution branch, including failed attempts, discarded samples, wrong-label transcripts and aborts. Bounds apply for n>=2 with n=1 explicitly finite; all outside constants are absolute. total charged sequential work T is O(n^(9/2) (log2 n) 2^((564341027/250000000)sqrt(n))). This complete envelope includes every operation/allocation assigned to that resource by rules.md, with explicit known exponential coefficient564341027/250000000 and exact growth index1/2. The supported structured object is this same envelope, not an inferred unknown inside-exponent coefficient.
